课程简介（中文）

本课程将先从文化的大视角出发，再看音乐本体，然后再从音乐中体验不同民族的文化精神。正所谓是一种走入“人们生活世界中的音乐景观”。课程教学有
听赏、解析，也有动手操作，还有对世界通史、田野调查等文化性方面的思考，是一种可持续性发展，生态式的艺术教学尝试。本课程以美国音乐人类学家
Titon的音乐文化分类模式为主要的教学思路，将音乐分为：1、音乐的观念 2、音乐的社会组织 3、音乐的曲库 4、音乐的物质文化这四个部分进行分类讲
解，并要求学生以这种思维进行理解式音乐学习体验。通过理解式的音乐欣赏教学，可以培养学生培养学生：1、融合不同知识的思维能力，2、平等看待且尊重
不同音乐文化价值的人文情怀，3、树立包容、宽容、理解的和谐人生观。

课程简介（英文）

This course will first start from a broad cultural perspective, then look at the ontology of music, and afterwards experience the cultural spirits of different ethnic groups through music. It can be said to be a kind of “musical landscape in people’s life world” that one steps into. The course teaching includes listening and appreciation, analysis, as well as hands - on operations, and also involves cultural - oriented thinking such as world general history and field investigations. It is a sustainable - development and ecological attempt at art teaching.

This course takes the music - culture classification model of American music anthropologist Titon as the main teaching idea. It classifies music into four parts for explanatory purposes: 1. Concepts of music; 2. Social organizations of music; 3. Repertoires of music; 4. Material cultures of music. And it requires students to have a comprehension - based music - learning experience with this way of thinking. Through comprehension - based music appreciation teaching, it can cultivate students to: 1. Develop the thinking ability to integrate different knowledge; 2. Foster a humanistic sentiment of treating and respecting the values of different music cultures equally; 3. Establish an inclusive, tolerant and understanding harmonious outlook on life.

教学目标

课程以美国音乐人类学家Tition的音乐文化分类模式为主要的教学思路，将音乐分为：1、音乐的观念  2、音乐的社会组织3、音乐的曲库  4、音乐的物质文化这四个部分进行分类讲解，并要求学生以这种思维进行理解式音乐学习体验。通过理解式的音乐欣赏教学，可以培养学生培养学生：1、融合不同知识的思维能力，2、平等看待且尊重不同音乐文化价值的人文情怀，3、树立包容、宽容、理解的和谐人生观。
